selection_explanation: Use VEP most_severe_consequence across ALL transcripts, then among transcripts carrying it choose MANE Select, canonical, protein_coding, lexical transcript_id. This is not VEP --pick.
gnomad_af: ALT global AC/AN, separate exomes and genomes; no summing cohorts
clinvar: Union of rsID and chrpos38 coordinate searches; exact GRCh38 CHROM/POS/REF/ALT match to ClassifiedRecord/SimpleAllele; germline aggregate classification, review status and contributing assertions retained
missing_value: NA = unavailable; not_found = successful search with no exact allele match, not proof of benignity
quality: Input QUAL/FILTER/INFO are missing; no genotype/sample FORMAT present
